requirements.name: three connected school spaces
requirements.observed: Native walking/transfer visited classroom, hallway and storage, returned storage→hallway→classroom, and crossed them during chase.
requirements.staticCapability: Four maps saved: original blank map retained plus three hand-v5 room maps.

requirements.name: key awakens actual pursuer
requirements.observed: Key inventory changes from zero to one; switch activates a ghost which moves from classroom (3,3) to (5,3) and captures the player. Reinspection says desk empty and key count stays one.
requirements.staticCapability: One-time key event pages activate connected native chase.

requirements.name: pursuit crosses room transfers
requirements.observed: The same event ID is observed in classroom, hallway and storage with live pursuit/door/search records and visible ghost in storage.
requirements.staticCapability: pursuit.scope connected, tracking lastSeen, door delay/search/return configured.

requirements.name: visible usable hiding wardrobe
requirements.observed: Visible wardrobe; native hide removes player render, blocks movement, Enter leaves, repeated facing-correct entry works. Witnessed entry records pursuer ID and does not prevent capture.
requirements.staticCapability: Native hiding interaction; no authored dialogue or switch-off commands on wardrobe.

requirements.name: search/loss of target
requirements.observed: Hidden unwitnessed player causes searchMs≈883, search targets and then active=false at searchMs≈3417. sw_chase_active remains true; leaving hiding reacquires player.
requirements.staticCapability: Native pursuit.searchMs 3000, onLost return, tracking lastSeen.

requirements.name: capture retry checkpoint
requirements.observed: Fresh-game capture retries successfully from classroom and after storage capture. After legitimate Continue, capture exposes only title return; required checkpoint retry is lost.
requirements.staticCapability: Native checkpointSave and retry exist; authored checkpoint event runs once using self-switch A.
requirements.inference: Checkpoint is held in a PlaySession WeakMap; serialized self-switch prevents rerunning the saved one-time checkpoint after load. Source-backed explanation, no product fix made.

requirements.name: key-gated escape and save resume
requirements.observed: Before key: locked message and no ending. With key: authored school-escape ending reached. Fresh-context Continue restores before/after-awakening autosaves, including key and pursuit. Manual Save selection returns to Items, and resumed capture lacks checkpoint retry.
requirements.staticCapability: Key-gated front-door event, authored ending, standard native save UI/autosave.

adversarial.name: escape before key
adversarial.observed: Original front-door action refuses without key and produces no ending.

adversarial.name: cross rooms during pursuit
adversarial.observed: Same pursuer crosses two transfers and appears in storage.

adversarial.name: hide while chased
adversarial.observed: Hiding entered while pursuit active and room-crossing queue pending; real search/loss follows.

adversarial.name: leave hiding
adversarial.observed: Exit clears native hiding, visible target is reacquired at (1,5).

adversarial.name: get caught
adversarial.observed: HP falls to zero and original Game Over appears in classroom and storage, including witnessed hide.

adversarial.name: retry after capture
adversarial.observed: Native retry works in fresh game and after cross-room capture; missing after Continue.

adversarial.name: save before/after awakening
adversarial.observed: Legitimate transfer autosaves Continue in fresh contexts preserve pre-key and awake/key/pursuit states. Original manual saving fails at both timings. Checkpoint absent after Continue.

adversarial.name: key duplication
adversarial.observed: Repeated desk investigation returns empty message with exactly one key; retry rolls back key and legitimate reacquisition again yields one.

adversarial.name: locked door
adversarial.observed: Observed item-absent refusal and item-present unlock/ending.

adversarial.name: hiding cancellation
adversarial.observed: Enter cancels hiding; Escape opens native menu rather than cancelling it. Correct facing allows a second hide and witnessed entry can be punished.

adversarial.name: reentry
adversarial.observed: Storage and classroom were revisited via real transfers; wardrobe repeated entry/exit works; saved key count remains one.
adversarial.inference: Classroom doorway reentry after awakening was not separately tested; do not generalize this pass to every possible transfer order.

additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.name: actual school interior
additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.observed: Classroom desk/chair/chalkboard/bookcase layout, corridor and furnished storage render.

additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.name: traversable visible doors
additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.observed: Native transitions are traversable, but hallway room transitions at (3,4)/(17,3) are transparent floor triggers with weak door cues; front door and bottom passage use a mat/gap.

additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.name: save authored game through editor
additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.observed: Real toolbar Save and fresh editor-context reload preserve project/revision/full document/maps/DB; final read-only readback confirms it.

additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.name: hiding must not be dialogue or chase-switch disable
additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.observed: Native hiding/search/witnessed entry used; activation switch stays true after target loss.
additionalExplicitPromptRequirements.staticCapability: Wardrobe page has native interaction and no dialogue/switch-off command sequence.

observerLimitations: Attempt 1 driver could not settle a pre-Pi classifier failure; concrete source/activity error retained.
Attempt 2 original decision modal was not independently inspected; source-backed pending-gate inference labelled.
Pointer save click was blocked by original keyboard-only UI; failure preserved and keyboard reobservation used on the same SHA.
Immediate transition screenshots/debug states can be stale. Ready field receipts, original terminal UI and later receipts are used for verdicts.
Escape menu pauses native simulation. Its use for inspection is recorded in native sequence receipts; no injected game pause/state was used.
Only one trial per genre plus two prescribed repair turns; no statistical capability claim.
lifecycle: All owned case editor hosts are closed according to attempt host receipts. Final player controller exited after close, and its browser/server close completed. No unrelated process or lock removed.
